title: Safecast Reading Weekly Battery Voltage Trend
dataSources: Seismograph (`seismo:reading`), Geiger counter (`geiger:cpm`), lightning strikes (`lightning:strike`), radon (`radon:reading`), all-sky meteor camera (`allsky:capture`), river-level gauge (`riverlevel:reading`), magnetometer (`magnetometer:reading`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`).
app: DIY citizen-science sensors — Raspberry Shake seismograph, Geiger counter, AS3935/Blitzortung lightning detector, radon monitor, all-sky meteor camera, river-level gauge, and magnetometer — via MQTT and scripted inputs to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=safecast:reading battery_v=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(battery_v) as avg_duration, max(battery_v) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst battery voltage for Safecast reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture battery_v on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average battery voltage with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It scans whether Safecast reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
